verdict.rationale: The only SDK-related evidence is Stripe's llms.txt, which tells users to check the npm registry when installing Stripe packages. That implies official client packages exist, and the documented Tax Calculations and Transactions APIs (docs-15, docs-16) are what such packages would wrap, but nothing names a Tax-specific SDK or its supported languages. The CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs, language coverage, SDK usage examples for the Tax APIs, independent corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
The standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs lets you calculate tax, record transactions, and handle reversals directly.
